acceptance: A ship with a missing close condition leaves the incident open (red first)
A ship with all conditions closes it
A recovery retrospective is written at enforce
fix: On the ship of a repair item, call the I-14 close check; the incident closes only when all conditions hold and the recovery retrospective exists, else a second try is recorded.
summary: Spec section 18 steps 5 and 6: verify the close conditions and write the recovery retrospective (ADR-0151). X16 stops at the filed item.
title: Self-healing X16f: close the incident on ship by the four I-14 conditions and the recovery retrospective
